harness_notes: Each eval seeds a prior session from `files[0]` (passed via --append-system-prompt) and then sends `prompt` (with-skill, plugin loaded) or `baseline_prompt` (no plugin). The format checks (label, dash or colon, one sentence, 7 items) measure the output format this skill exists to produce; the baseline prompt doesn't ask for it, so most of this skill's delta is format compliance by design. The coverage checks measure whether the content survives the compression.

evals.expected_output: A numbered list with no preamble, each item a bold short label plus one plain sentence, covering the four causes (N+1 queries, blocking carousel, oversized hero image, session-keyed cache) and the suggested order. No hedging filler, no new information.
expectations: No preamble: the first line is list item 1
Every item is formatted `N. **Label** — sentence`
7 items or fewer
Every label is 4 words or fewer
Each item is a single sentence
Covers all four causes: N+1 queries, the blocking carousel, the hero image, the session-keyed cache
No open-decisions line (nothing is left open)
